METRIC: Active Member
DEFINITION: Active on a day if the highest-priority status
            that day is ACTIVE. Active for the month if active
            on at least one day within it.
EXCLUDES:   A month-end-only snapshot -- that misses anyone
            who paused before the month closed.
OWNER:      Analytics Engineering, change requires sign-off
            from Finance, Marketing, and Product.
